consumers.proof: Consumer is strictly inside an ORIGINAL individual road polygon (not a union/buffer artifact) and away from every existing network. Any continuous final approach has a nonzero terminal interval inside that road. A road passage requires polygon plus 3 m beyond BOTH boundaries; the terminal has no exterior continuation. The 29.09 §13 exception is only for chambers on existing networks, not this consumer. Changing own-OKS exit, target, detour, road-union construction or depth cannot remove this local obstruction.
consumers.witness: No valid witness can satisfy that local necessary condition. SyntheticRoadConflictsTest checks two different attachment directions with ResultValidator and requires SECTION_OUTSIDE naming the containing road.
